title: App bundle
description: One document that holds an app's definition, as POST /api/v1/apps/{slug}/bundle exports it and POST /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/bundle-import reads it. It never holds a secret, a token, a member, a comment, history or an attachment. Importing one makes a proposal, never a live app. The sha256 is the SHA-256 of the document without its own sha256, written as compact JSON with the keys sorted, and detects damage. A bundle holds at most 5,000 sample records in all; this schema limits each table, and the server counts all of them.

manifest.description: The app. Its workspace, coordinates and custom domain stay behind: they belong to the place it lived.

views.description: Collaborative and locked saved views. A person's own view is never included. An import gives each one an id of its own.

rules.description: The app's process rules. A rule's id is unique across apps, so an import gives a rule a new id when another app holds its id.

page_sources.description: The source of each custom page, filed under its SHA-256. The bundle holds every source its pages run, and each hashes to its key.

webhooks.description: Webhooks without their secrets. Each arrives off and needs its own approval, a host on the outbound allowlist, and the named secret supplied by the importing workspace.

enabled.description: Ignored on import: a webhook arrives off.

secret_name.description: The name of the secret the webhook needs. Never its value.

sample_data.description: Optional sample records by table id, with the sensitive fields removed. Each record is its field values.
